quotations.old_english: Oft wǽron teónan wǽrfæstra wera weredum gemǽne, heardum hearmplega
quotations.latin: Facta est rixa inter pastores gregum Abram et Lot, Gen. 13, 7

source_text: hearm-plega. Add: -- Oft wǽron teónan wǽrfæstra wera weredum gemǽne, heardum hearmplega (cf. Facta est rixa inter pastores gregum Abram et Lot, Gen. 13, 7).
